استجدين (form X)
# اِسْتَجْدَيْنَ (istajdayna) /is.tad͡ʒ.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# اُسْتُجْدِينَ (ustujdīna) /us.tud͡ʒ.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
# اِسْتَجْدِينَ (istajdīna) /is.tad͡ʒ.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْدَى (istajdā)
